# Reflection Model

## Model Chosen

![](images/Screenshot%202025-11-26%20at%2016.27.23.png){width="363"}

## Reason for the Choice

-   Structured approach to reflect a certain event.

-   More constructive action plans to solve any problems.

## Reflecting on MSc experience

-   Description: Finishing first term of the MSc course

-   Feelings: Tired, doubts, nervous, proud.

-   Evaluation:

    -   Enjoyed being back in academic environment.

    -   Understood all course content.

    -   Balanced life involvement with study responsibilities

    -   Lots of pressure from PhD application

    -   Have not taken more opportunities to do extra work beyond curriculum of the course

-   Analysis:

    -   Reduce the amount of social commitment next term.

    -   Plan better each week and do more long-term planning.
